title: United Russia Claims Record Duma Election Victory Amid Fraud Allegations
detail: Results from Russia's State Duma elections (held Sep 18-20, 2026 — the first since the full-scale invasion of Ukraine, and the first to include ballots cast in four annexed Ukrainian regions) showed Putin's United Russia party winning a supermajority. The Communist Party took 40 seats (13.8% of the vote), the nationalist LDPR won 25 seats, and the New People party won 20 seats. Opposition-aligned Yabloko candidates were excluded from the ballot. Western observers and opposition groups labeled the vote a sham, citing the exclusion of genuine opposition, ballots cast in occupied territory, and widespread irregularities.

media.caption: Putin's United Russia party wins a supermajority in Russia's State Duma elections

title: EU Pledges Sanctions on Organizers of Russia's Duma Election
detail: EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas said Brussels will impose new sanctions on organizers of Russia's Sep 18-20 State Duma election, including candidates who stood in occupied Ukrainian territories and officials responsible for what the EU called the 'continued and deepening erosion of democracy in Russia.' Kallas cited the exclusion of Yabloko candidates as further narrowing choices available to Russian voters.

media.caption: EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas pledges new sanctions over Russia's Duma election
